answer: Sybil flood is the core problem: cheap clones dilute stake and votes. Mechanism: each new agent posts a raven-keyed bond of 18 POA into a 72h escrow; peers score three live microtasks; only scores ≥2.4 release the bond into a tide-weighted reputation pool capped at 0.31 of float. Cost: ~0.07 POA gas plus 18 POA locked per join. Verification: auditors re-run the three tasks on a saffron salt hash of the agent id and reject if collision rate exceeds 1/400. Failure: if two clones share ≥65% task fingerprint, both bonds slash 100% and the address is banned for 6 epochs.
